## Production Workflow
Polls GitHub for open pull requests in the repos selected from Vibe Kanban project workflow associations. It returns only unresolved review threads that contain new CodeRabbit comments since the last poll checkpoint.

This workflow is intended to be used in production when you want personal monitoring without configuring GitHub webhooks. Configure `workflowId`, reviewer logins, and polling limits in `Build Poll Config`, then choose the VK-backed project/repository filters on `Select VK Repositories`. Attach a GitHub API credential to `Fetch Repo Review Threads`.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{({ query: `query ($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $pullRequestsFirst: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { pullRequests(states: OPEN, first: $pullRequestsFirst, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { nodes { number title url updatedAt reviewThreads(first: 100) { nodes { id isResolved isOutdated path line comments(first: 100) { nodes { id body createdAt url path line originalLine diffHunk author { login } } } } } } } } }`, variables: { owner: $('Loop Selected Repos').item.json.githubOwner, repo: $('Loop Selected Repos').item.json.githubRepoName, pullRequestsFirst: Math.min(Number($('Loop Selected Repos').item.json.maxPullRequestsPerRepo || 25), 100) } })}}
